records.question: There are four lamps in Valerie's room. All of them are burnt out, so she needs to buy new light bulbs. She needs 3 small light bulbs and 1 large light bulb. She has $60 to spend. If small light bulbs cost $8 and large light bulbs cost $12, how much money will Valerie have left over?
records.response:
Valerie needs to buy 3 small light bulbs, so she will spend 3 * 8 = $24 on small light bulbs.
She also needs to buy 1 large light bulb, so she will spend 1 * 12 = $12 on the large light bulb.
In total, Valerie will spend 24 + 12 = $36 on light bulbs.
She has $60 to spend, so she will have 60 - 36 = $24 left over.
#### 24

records.question: A fifth-grade class went on a field trip to the zoo, and their class of 10 students merged with another class with the same amount of students. 5 parents offered to be a chaperone, and 2 of the teachers from both classes will be there too. When the school day was over, the students could choose to go home and 10 of them left. Two of the chaperones were parents in that group, so they left as well. How many individuals were left at the zoo?
records.response:
The total number of students in the two classes was 10+10 = 20.
The total number of chaperones in the two classes was 5+2 = 7.
The total number of people at the zoo was 20+7 = 27.
When 10 students left, there were 20-10 = 10 left.
Two of the chaperones left, so there were 7-2 = 5 chaperones left.
The total number of people left at the zoo was 10+5 = 15.
#### 15
